answer: A sybil-resistant economy can graft every new account onto a slow-growing vine: newcomers earn weight only as established members stake reputation behind them, and each vouch is set in marble - permanent, public, costly to forge. A backer whose shoot proves a clone forfeits that stake, so lending names to puppet farms drains the gardener. Escrowed jade per endorsement prices mass identities out of reach, leaving influence to patient, vouched roots.
